runs.budget_policy: total target minus Python model and warm-start construction; minimum 1ms solver; cleanup included in actual total

cutoff.policy: first largest complete incumbent and latest bound available by deadline; terminal evidence requires cleanup completion

settings.output: training-mode forward before parameter update of that step
settings.gradient_check: finite loss each step; final completed gradient check only
settings.decode_problem: original problem, even if objective/message constraints differ
settings.selection: first maximum feasible candidate completed by cutoff
settings.timing: construction, hashes, training and online decoding included; actual emission latency saved
